tables:
SELECT tablename AS name
            FROM pg_tables
            WHERE schemaname='public'
            ORDER BY tablename COLLATE "C"
columns:
SELECT table_name AS table, column_name AS name, ordinal_position AS position,
                   data_type AS type, udt_name AS udt, is_nullable AS nullable,
                   COALESCE(column_default, '') AS default_value,
                   COALESCE(character_maximum_length, 0) AS max_length,
                   COALESCE(numeric_precision, 0) AS precision,
                   COALESCE(numeric_scale, 0) AS scale
            FROM information_schema.columns
            WHERE table_schema='public'
            ORDER BY table_name COLLATE "C", ordinal_position
indexes:
SELECT tablename AS table, indexname AS name, indexdef AS definition
            FROM pg_indexes
            WHERE schemaname='public'
            ORDER BY tablename COLLATE "C", indexname COLLATE "C"
constraints:
SELECT c.conrelid::regclass::text AS table, c.conname AS name,
                   c.contype AS type, pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid, true) AS definition,
                   c.convalidated AS validated, c.condeferrable AS deferrable,
                   c.condeferred AS initially_deferred
            FROM pg_constraint c
            JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.connamespace
            -- PostgreSQL 18 records column NOT NULL clauses in pg_constraint
            -- with contype='n'. The manifest already compares nullability in
            -- information_schema.columns, so exclude this duplicate catalog
            -- representation while retaining PK/UNIQUE/FK/CHECK constraints.
            WHERE n.nspname='public'
              
              AND c.contype <> 'n'
            ORDER BY c.conrelid::regclass::text COLLATE "C", c.conname COLLATE "C"
functions:
SELECT p.proname AS name,
                   pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments,
                   pg_get_function_result(p.oid) AS result,
                   l.lanname AS language, p.provolatile AS volatility,
                   p.proisstrict AS strict, p.prosecdef AS security_definer,
                   p.prosrc AS source
            FROM pg_proc p
            JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
            JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang
            WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.prokind='f'
            ORDER BY p.proname COLLATE "C", pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) COLLATE "C"
